title: AI-Powered Payroll Solution (AI Payroll Guard)
summary: The UAE Ministry of Finance reports that its live AI-enabled payroll system reduced processing time by up to 95%. AI's share of the wider automation gain is not isolated.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: The UAE Ministry of Finance reports that its live AI-enabled payroll system reduced processing time by up to 95%. AI's share of the wider automation gain is not isolated. Live federal payroll implementation. The chapter reports the stated benefit but does not independently verify it.
purpose: Automate payroll processing, validation, and exception handling.
deployer: UAE Ministry of Finance and federal entities

ratings.reason: The Ministry reports up to 95% less payroll-processing time. The rating describes the time saving, while AI's share of the wider automation change remains unisolated.
Timely, accurate salaries are an intended benefit; the chapter does not measure changes in missed or erroneous payments.

ai_role.statement: AI is described as validating payroll data, detecting exceptions, and supporting the interface. Other automation also executes processing and payments, so AI's separate contribution is unknown.

evidence.citation: Contributed use case in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. The reported outcomes are attributed to the submitting project, not an independent outcome evaluation by ITU.
evidence.title: Use Case 4: AI-Powered Payroll Solution (AI Payroll Guard)

produced_by: Causal conditions are not established separately in the extracted chapter.
must_hold: Payroll data validation and human approval checkpoints

headline: AI Payroll Guard cuts federal payroll processing time

revisions.change: Added the sourced case with separate benefit depth, beneficiary, evidence confidence, and outcome status assessments.

claim_basis: The makers' report is on file. There is no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
